steps.says: An evil man named Bardif lost his son Tarlin to kidnappers. Learn what you can from Mergmar, his butler in Qeynos, without Bardif knowing. Show him my token.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-3-good.json, Group 3, Level 30, Requirements (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). One of these a 1-20 class chain: it follows 1-20/tethelin/druid/L20, so a druid of Tethelin is sent on. Daresh's token opens Group 3's path quests (Mergmar asks to see it).

quests.name: Daresh of Murnf
quests.offer: You have learned all I can teach you. Your path goes on in Murnf: Daresh, upstairs in the building west of the coach, needs someone who can ask questions quietly.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and do not forget what you learned here.

steps.journal: Find Daresh in Murnf, upstairs in the building west of the coach.
steps.says: An evil man named Bardif lost his son Tarlin to kidnappers. Learn what you can from Mergmar, his butler in Qeynos, without Bardif knowing. Show him my token.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-3-good.json, Group 3, Level 30, Requirements (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). One of these a 1-20 class chain: it follows 1-20/tethelin/ranger/L20, so a ranger of Tethelin is sent on. Daresh's token opens Group 3's path quests (Mergmar asks to see it).

quests.name: The Lightwolf Jewels
quests.offer: You have learned all I can teach you. Your path goes on at Castle Lightwolf: Dixxon Tristar, east of the coachman, has need of someone like you.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and do not forget what you learned here.

steps.journal: Find Dixxon Tristar in Castle Lightwolf, east of the coachman.
steps.says: The castle's elemental jewels are stolen, and Deputy Sools filed a report about one of them. Take my writ to him; he waits outside, by the left tower.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-2-good.json, Group 2, Level 30, Requirements (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). One of these a 1-20 class chain: it follows 1-20/tethelin/rogue/L20, so a rogue of Tethelin is sent on. Dixxon's writ opens Group 2's path quests (Deputy Sools asks to see it).

quests.name: The Runed Clay Tablet
quests.offer: Argot Bittersteel in Blakedown, west and south of the Dagnor's Cauldron coach, lost goods in Al-Karad's Ruin, and a savage bear there carries the clay tablet. Show him my note.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Show Crikston's note to Argot Bittersteel, first building on the right in Blakedown.
steps.says: Crikston's errand, then. My goods are in the back room of Al-Karad's Ruin, north of town. And a savage bear out there swallowed the tablet he wants.
steps.notyet: Crikston's business? Bring me his note and we will talk.

steps.journal: Go down the ramp in Al-Karad's Ruin to the back room and find Argot's goods.

events.text: Among the rubble of the back room you find the goods Argot lost. The dead here do not rest: kill what comes at you.

steps.journal: Kill the savage bear that roams outside the ruins and take the runed clay tablet.
Bring Argot Bittersteel his goods.
steps.says: My goods, and Crikston's tablet besides. Keep the tablet for him. Take this for your trouble.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-1-good.json, Group 1, Level 30, Expedition A (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's loot room asks every creature in it be killed; here the back room is a place to reach (EQOA-Data's map point), and its dead are the ruin's own. Any savage bear drops the tablet (the guide's is the one round the ruins).

quests.name: The Runed Stone Tablet
quests.offer: Two-Eyed Jack in Trail's End, down the long road south of Highpass, knows where the stone tablet went. Show him my note.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Show Crikston's note to Two-Eyed Jack in Trail's End, south of Highpass.
steps.says: Crikston, eh? Then find out what happened to Maximillian Scriber. He took the long road north and never came back. Try the cave on the right side of the road.
steps.notyet: Who sent you? Bring me something from Crikston.

steps.journal: Fight into the cave on the road north of Trail's End and kill the Silvermist Alpha for Maximillian's journal.
Bring Maximillian's journal to Two-Eyed Jack.
steps.says: So the wolves had him. The tablet is Crikston's; keep it for him. Wear this belt, I made it myself.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-1-good.json, Group 1, Level 30, Expedition B (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The Silvermist Alpha is a triggered spawn in the guide; here she stands in the cave where FrontiersForge saw her. She drops the journal and the tablet together.

quests.name: The Runed Bronze Tablet
quests.offer: Finnus Sodwin, second floor of the Black Swan Inn south of the Dagnor's Cauldron coach, knows who has the bronze tablet. Show him my note.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Show Crikston's note to Finnus Sodwin, second floor of the Black Swan Inn.
steps.says: The gnoll Skarr has it, deep in Blackburrow past the Gnoll Fort. Kill him and bring me his bronze headpiece.
steps.notyet: I talk to Crikston's people. Are you one?

steps.journal: Kill Skarr at the back of the hidden cavern in Blackburrow.
Bring Skarr's bronze headpiece to Finnus Sodwin.
steps.says: Skarr is dead. Keep the tablet for Crikston, and this purse for yourself.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-1-good.json, Group 1, Level 30, Expedition C (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT).

quests.name: Three Tablets for Crikston
quests.offer: You have all three tablets? Then bring them to me, with my note.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Then let me see them.

steps.journal: Give the clay, stone and bronze tablets and Crikston's note to Crikston Gundlefop.
steps.says: Clay, stone and bronze! Your trainer in Forkwatch shall hear of this. Take what you have earned: your path is yours.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-1-good.json, Group 1, Level 30, Quest completion (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Crikston gives the final rewards himself (the guide: a letter for the Forkwatch trainer, who gives them; one step serves every class). The guide's choices: the first ability on each class's line and the first weapon that exists here (clerics the Benevolent Battlehammer: no Holy Forgehammer; wizards a Staff of Tears made like a staff of the level). The guide names no alchemist weapon.

quests.name: The Third Paraphet Rod
quests.offer: I need three paraphet rods. Two are on their way; the third is with Twindle Fizzmop, behind the blacksmith in Freeport. Get it from him.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and mind your purse with that gnome.

steps.journal: Find Twindle Fizzmop behind the blacksmith in Freeport.
steps.says: The rod? Bring me the Sceptre of Tal'Thaz and 3,000 tunar. Rauntet has it, in the undead valley of Al'Farak Ruins west of the Nashier camp.

steps.journal: Kill Rauntet in the undead valley of Al'Farak Ruins and take the Sceptre of Tal'Thaz.
Bring the sceptre and 3,000 tunar to Twindle Fizzmop.
steps.says: A pleasure. Here is your rod.

steps.journal: Bring the paraphet rod to Crikston Gundlefop.
steps.says: The rod! Wait, who is that? An assassin! Kill him!

steps.journal: Kill the assassin who came for Crikston and search him.
Tell Crikston Gundlefop about the druidic symbol.
steps.says: A druid's symbol on an assassin? Shiol Anara in Surefall Glade will know it.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-1-good.json, Group 1, Level 40 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Rauntet stands where FrontiersForge saw him (the guide's is a triggered spawn). The 3,000 tunar is the haggled price (5,000 unhaggled). The assassin stands in Crikston's room, where FrontiersForge saw the one the guide has come when the rod is handed over.

quests.name: The Great Bear Spirit
quests.offer: Take the symbol to Shiol Anara in Surefall Glade. Whoever sent that assassin, she can find out.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Show the druidic symbol to Shiol Anara in Surefall Glade.
steps.says: Urisai, the great bear spirit, will know it. Bring him an offering: the bow of the poacher McGee, a jade drake's wing and a tainted wolf's hide.

steps.journal: Kill Trapper McGee, who roams Surefall Glade past the lake, for his bow.
Kill jade drakes in Salisearaneen until one gives up a wing.
Kill tainted wolves in Mariel Village until you have a whole hide.
Bring the offering to Urisai at the druid ring in Surefall Glade.
steps.says: The symbol is of the Night Callers, who hide in the Unkempt North. Tell your master.

steps.journal: Tell Crikston Gundlefop who sent the assassin.
steps.says: The Night Callers. Then they will try again.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-1-good.json, Group 1, Level 40 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide has Shiol send the player back with the three items and Urisai appear after half a minute at the druid ring; here Urisai stands at the ring (FrontiersForge's place) and takes the offering.

quests.name: The Examiner's Lens
quests.offer: One thing more: the lens of an Evil Eye Examiner. One lives in the right tunnel of Moss Mouth Cavern, with goblin guards.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill the Evil Eye Examiner in the right tunnel of Moss Mouth Cavern and take its lens.
Bring the examiner lens to Crikston Gundlefop.
steps.says: With this I can see what they are planning. Your trainer will hear of you. Take this.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-1-good.json, Group 1, Level 40, Quest completion (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Crikston gives the rewards (the guide: the class trainer in Forkwatch, after a minute). The choices: the first ability on the class's line and the first weapon that exists here (paladins the Hammer of Virtue, clerics the Sacrosanct Warhammer, wizards the Wand of War: their first choices are not in this database). No alchemist weapon is named.

quests.name: The Amulet of Protection
quests.offer: Four seals hold a great evil in the north. To reach the first you need protection: Anya Spiritdottir in Binshore, south of Wyndhaven on the coast, will tell you how. Keep all you are given.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and keep everything.

steps.journal: Find Anya Spiritdottir in Binshore, on the coast south of Wyndhaven.
steps.says: Halsfur Whitepaw makes the amulet. He lives in the glowing blue bear cave in the Snowblind Plains, along a ledge on the right wall of the big room. Bring 5,000 tunar.

steps.journal: Find Halsfur Whitepaw along the ledge in the bear cave of the Snowblind Plains.
steps.says: An amulet costs a scratched worm chitin and 5,000 tunar. The great worms of Permafrost have the chitin.

steps.journal: Kill great worms in Permafrost until one has a scratched chitin.
Bring the chitin and 5,000 tunar to Halsfur Whitepaw.
steps.says: Wear this in the burial ground and it will not kill you.

steps.journal: Return to Crikston Gundlefop with the Amulet of Protection.
steps.says: Good. Now the seals.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-1-good.json, Group 1, Level 49 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT).

quests.name: The First Seal
quests.offer: The first seal is in the Heyokah Burial Ground, in the Spirit Talkers Woods: run east from Murnf to a lake. Wear the amulet, or the ground will kill you.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Show the Amulet of Protection to the Caretaker of the Heyokah Burial Ground.
steps.says: You may walk here. Then face the Eidolon of Malice, and bring me its essence.
steps.notyet: Without protection the ground will eat you alive. Go.

steps.journal: Kill the Eidolon of Malice and take its essence orb.
Bring the essence orb to the Caretaker.
steps.says: Malice is bound again. Take the Spiritwalker's Totem: it is the first seal.

steps.journal: Tell Crikston Gundlefop you hold the first seal.
steps.says: One of four.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-1-good.json, Group 1, Level 49, The First Seal (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's black orb portal, its 650 damage a tick without the amulet and the timed trial are not in: the Caretaker asks to see the amulet. The Caretaker and the Eidolon stand where FrontiersForge and EQOA-Data's map put them.

quests.name: The Second Seal
quests.offer: Oransan has come down to Highpass from the north; he stands by me, and knows where the second seal went.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Speak with Oransan in Highpass Hold, by Crikston Gundlefop.
steps.says: The Slar keeps it, in the Den of the Grave Wolves in north-east Salisearaneen. Clear the wolves and take the Shield of Orthimius from him.

steps.journal: Kill The Slar in the Den of the Grave Wolves and take the Shield of Orthimius.
Show the Shield of Orthimius to Oransan.
steps.says: The second seal. Keep it safe.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-1-good.json, Group 1, Level 49, The Second Seal (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide's Oransan is downstairs in the Highpass Inn; ours stands by Crikston (the Snowblind Plains' Oransan does too).

quests.name: The Third Seal
quests.offer: The third seal is Frostcleaver, in Permafrost. Kill Frostborn III where he roams by Vox's castle, drive his sword into the ice throne, and take the blade from Frostborn II.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Mind the Voxite wizards: they see the invisible.

steps.journal: Kill Frostborn III in the halls of Permafrost and take his sword.
Drive Frostborn's sword into the ice throne in the throne room.

events.text: You drive the sword into the ice throne. The ice cracks, and Frostborn II comes to claim his kingdom.

steps.journal: Kill Frostborn II and take Frostcleaver.
Tell Crikston Gundlefop you hold the third seal.
steps.says: Three of four.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-1-good.json, Group 1, Level 49, The Third Seal (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Frostborn II stands in the throne room always (the guide's rises when the sword is driven in); the throne is a place to reach, beside him.

quests.name: The Fourth Seal
quests.offer: The fourth seal is the Unnamed Crown. In the Unnamed King's castle in Anu Village, kill Tolo Grimsteel and Ganron Lorebane for their gems, then call up the king himself.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill Tolo Grimsteel in the Unnamed King's castle in Anu Village and take his gem.
Kill Ganron Lorebane and take his gem.
Call up the Unnamed King at the column, kill him and take his crown.
Tell Crikston Gundlefop you hold all four seals.
steps.says: Four of four. Now Oransan.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-1-good.json, Group 1, Level 49, The Fourth Seal (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The Unnamed King stands in his castle always (the guide's is called up at a column with both gems). His crown is the database's Crown of the Unnamed.

quests.name: Parathior
quests.offer: Take all four seals to Oransan at the broken tower in the north Snowblind Plains, west of the bear cave. He will call Parathior down. Bring me what is left of it.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and save everything.

steps.journal: Show the four seals to Oransan at the broken tower in the north Snowblind Plains.
steps.says: All four. Speak with Orinas while I begin; then the ice will fall from the sky.

steps.journal: Speak with Orinas, the bear, beside Oransan.
steps.says: When it is done, the weapon you have earned will be yours. Now, look up!

steps.journal: Kill Parathior and take a chunk of its ice.
Bring the ice chunk to Crikston Gundlefop.
steps.says: It is over. Take your reward, and when you have grown to the height of your power, the Recruiter will have work for you.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-1-good.json, Group 1, Level 49, Parathior and Quest completion (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The ritual's five minutes are not in; Parathior stands by the tower (the guide's comes down from the sky). Crikston gives the final rewards; the guide's class NPC (bards Kaldesh Illinor in the Freeport tavern) and the approval visits to the givers of the level 20, 30 and 40 quests are not in. Epic weapons are epics_49.json's: the first that exists here (paladins Virtus Ferrum, no Judgement; clerics a Hammer of Absolution made like a hammer of the level).

quests.name: The Red Elemental Necklace
quests.offer: Deputy Sools, by the left tower outside, reported one of our elemental jewels. Show him my writ and help him get it back.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Show Dixxon's writ to Deputy Sools, by the left tower outside Castle Lightwolf.
steps.says: Dixxon's agent, good. Sissy Hasper saw a dark drake wearing a red necklace. She lives in the southernmost house of the village south of the castle.
steps.notyet: I report to Dixxon Tristar, not to strangers.

steps.journal: Find Sissy Hasper in the southernmost house of the village in the south of North Wilderlands.
steps.says: A dark drake with a red necklace round its neck! It flew off to the south-west of Guardian Forest.

steps.journal: Kill the dark drake in south-west Guardian Forest for the red elemental necklace.
Bring the red elemental necklace to Deputy Sools.
steps.says: One of four. Captain Benta, outside Halas, has word of a white bracelet.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-2-good.json, Group 2, Level 30, Red Elemental Necklace (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT).

quests.name: The White Elemental Bracelet
quests.offer: Captain Benta, outside Halas, saw a majestic Freezeblood wearing a white bracelet. Go to her.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Find Captain Benta outside Halas.
steps.says: A Freezeblood Majestic wears it, west of Halas in the north of Guardian Forest.

steps.journal: Kill the Freezeblood Majestic in the north of Guardian Forest for the white bracelet.
Bring the white elemental bracelet to Deputy Sools.
steps.says: Two of four. Captain Rulina has news of a blue ring.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-2-good.json, Group 2, Level 30, White Elemental Bracelet (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT).

quests.name: The Blue Elemental Ring
quests.offer: Captain Rulina, in Halas, has word of the blue ring. Go to her.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Find Captain Rulina in Halas.
steps.says: Mirea saw it. She lives in the faerie village of Salisearaneen, by a small well: take the path east off the southern road past the inn.

steps.journal: Find Mirea by the small well in the faerie village of Salisearaneen.
steps.says: An ebony wolf wears it, in the south of Guardian Forest.

steps.journal: Kill the ebony wolf in the south of Guardian Forest for the blue ring.
Bring the blue elemental ring to Deputy Sools.
steps.says: Three of four. Juno Inhop, at the inn south-east of the castle, knows of a green earring.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-2-good.json, Group 2, Level 30, Blue Elemental Ring (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT).

quests.name: The Green Elemental Earring
quests.offer: Juno Inhop, at the inn south-east of the castle, knows of the green earring. Go to him.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Find Juno Inhop at the inn south-east of Castle Lightwolf.
steps.says: A frosteye scarecrow has it: in the valley between two mountains south-west of Diren Hold, toward Mount Hatespike.

steps.journal: Kill the frosteye scarecrow in the valley south-west of Diren Hold for the green earring.
Bring the green elemental earring to Deputy Sools.
steps.says: All four. One thing more: Merchant Balboa in Halas keeps a lockbox for us.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-2-good.json, Group 2, Level 30, Green Elemental Earring (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT).

quests.name: The Lockbox
quests.offer: Merchant Balboa, by the windmill in Halas, holds a lockbox for the castle. It will cost you 1,585 tunar. Bring it here.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Mind the purse: Balboa does not haggle.

steps.journal: Pay Merchant Balboa, by the windmill in Halas, 1,585 tunar for the lockbox.
steps.says: Here it is, safe and sound.

steps.journal: Bring the lockbox to Deputy Sools.
steps.says: That is everything. Take this letter to Dixxon.

steps.journal: Return to Dixxon Tristar in Castle Lightwolf.
steps.says: The jewels are home. Your guildmaster sends this, and so do I.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-2-good.json, Group 2, Level 30, Lockbox and Quest completion (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Dixxon gives the final rewards (the guide: the class guildmaster in the castle's west wing, which one step cannot be for every class). The choices: the first ability on each class's line (EQOA-Data's spell lists; the shaman's Sickening Wind, the next of the level 20 Decaying Wind) and the first weapon, made here like a weapon of the kind and level where this database lacks it (all but the warrior's Lycaon Slasher).

quests.name: The Green and White Talismans
quests.offer: Now our talismans are gone too. Fali Rugger, in the Murnf inn, has been asking about them. Find him.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Find Fali Rugger in the Murnf inn.
steps.says: Four talismans, and the beasts that took them. A forest night wolf by the Great Tree in the south of Murnf has the green; Delvar Rivers in the Wyndhaven inn knows of the white.

steps.journal: Kill the forest night wolf by the Great Tree in the south of Murnf for the green talisman.
Find Delvar Rivers in the Wyndhaven inn.
steps.says: An air elemental took the white one, west of the Great Tree in Murnf.

steps.journal: Kill the air elemental west of the Great Tree in Murnf for the white talisman.
Bring the green and white talismans to Dixxon Tristar.
steps.says: Two of them. Torgias Bullow and Keneto Barillo in Murnf know where the others went.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-2-good.json, Group 2, Level 40, Green and White Elemental Talismans (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide has each talisman brought to Dixxon as it is found; here two at a time. The forest night wolves see the invisible.

quests.name: The Blue and Red Talismans
quests.offer: Torgias Bullow, second house west of the Murnf coach, and Keneto Barillo, in the Murnf inn, know where the blue and red talismans went.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Find Torgias Bullow, in the second house west of the Murnf coach.
steps.says: The white-faced werewolf by the Great Tree took the blue one.

steps.journal: Kill the white-faced werewolf near the Great Tree in Murnf for the blue talisman.
Find Keneto Barillo in the Murnf inn.
steps.says: A ghoul has the red, north-west of where the werewolves run. It drains the power out of you: be ready.

steps.journal: Kill the ghoul north-west of the werewolves for the red talisman.
Bring the blue and red talismans to Dixxon Tristar.
steps.says: All four talismans. Now, Deputy Sools has gone after the lockbox, and has not come back.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-2-good.json, Group 2, Level 40, Blue and Red Elemental Talismans (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Any werewolf does (one stands by the Great Tree, EQOA-Data's map point).

quests.name: The Vampire of Jaeger Mansion
quests.offer: Deputy Sools went to Jaeger Mansion in the north of Twisted Tower after the lockbox. Buy a vampire testing kit from Huntress Lilly, north of the Murnf coach, and find him.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Bring 2,760 tunar, and go in quietly.

steps.journal: Buy a vampire testing kit from Huntress Lilly, north of the Murnf coach: 2,760 tunar.
steps.says: Use it well. The mansion's master is no man.

steps.journal: Find Deputy Sools at Jaeger Mansion, in the north of Twisted Tower, and test him.
steps.says: I am no vampire, but he is: Garou Red Claws has the lockbox. Kill him.

steps.journal: Kill Garou Red Claws in Jaeger Mansion for the lockbox.
Bring the lockbox to Dixxon Tristar.
steps.says: The lockbox, and Sools alive. Take your reward.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-2-good.json, Group 2, Level 40, Deputy Sools and Quest completion (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Deputy Sools is at the mansion at every hour (the guide's comes only at night, about :15 to :45). The choices: the first ability on the class's line and the first weapon, made like one of the kind and level where this database lacks it (the warrior's second, the Blood Drainer, is here: given instead of Daywalkers' Revenge).

quests.name: Old Red
quests.offer: Thurgrid McRaith in Halas has news of the seals that hold the north. Go to him, and keep everything you are given until the end.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Find Thurgrid McRaith in Halas.
steps.says: Old Red, the great eel off the coast of Zentar's Keep, swallowed one of the four orbs. Swim out to him and cut it out.

steps.journal: Swim out off the coast of Zentar's Keep and kill Old Red for the Orb of Halas Aquamarine.
Show the orb and the torn paper to Thurgrid McRaith.
steps.says: The paper names the other three: Ives Radain in Qeynos, Zebel Earblower in Rivervale, and Lord Tearis Thex in Fayspires.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-2-good.json, Group 2, Level 49, Old Red (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Old Red is in the water where FrontiersForge saw him (the guide's comes only to one in the ocean).

quests.name: The Orb of Qeynos Peridot
quests.offer: The paper Thurgrid read? Then you know: Bribro Mino, the minotaur in Gunter's Mine, has the peridot orb. Take it from him.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill Bribro Mino among the minotaurs of Gunter's Mine for the Orb of Qeynos Peridot.
Show the peridot orb to Ives Radain in Qeynos.
steps.says: Keep it with the others.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-2-good.json, Group 2, Level 49, Orb and Seal Chain (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide says Ives sends the player to Bribro Mino; Bribro stands among the minotaurs and is killed for the orb.

quests.name: The Orb of Rivervale Citrine
quests.offer: Commander Romar, with the Razgut south-west of Fort Alliance, keeps the citrine orb. Bring it back to us.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill Commander Romar among the Razgut south-west of Fort Alliance for the citrine orb.
Show the citrine orb to Zebel Earblower in Rivervale.
steps.says: Keep it with the others.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-2-good.json, Group 2, Level 49, Orb and Seal Chain (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide says Zebel sends the player to Commander Romar; Romar commands the Razgut there and is killed for the orb.

quests.name: The Orb of Fayspires Jade
quests.offer: The Tae Ew Keeper in Cazic Thule has the jade orb. Kill it, and bring the orb here.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill the Tae Ew Keeper in Cazic Thule for the jade orb.
Show the jade orb to Lord Tearis Thex in Fayspires.
steps.says: Four orbs. Now the seals of the north.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-2-good.json, Group 2, Level 49, Orb and Seal Chain (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT).

quests.name: The Third Seal
quests.offer: The third seal is Frostcleaver, in Permafrost. Kill Frostborn III where he roams by Vox's castle, drive his sword into the ice throne, and take the blade from Frostborn II.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Mind the Voxite wizards: they see the invisible.

steps.journal: Kill Frostborn III in the halls of Permafrost and take his sword.
Drive Frostborn's sword into the ice throne in the throne room.

events.text: You drive the sword into the ice throne. The ice cracks, and Frostborn II comes to claim his kingdom.

steps.journal: Kill Frostborn II and take Frostcleaver.
Tell Lord Tearis Thex you hold the third seal.
steps.says: Three of four.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-2-good.json, Group 2, Level 49, The Third Seal (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Frostborn II stands in the throne room always (the guide's rises when the sword is driven in); the throne is a place to reach, beside him.

quests.name: The Fourth Seal
quests.offer: The fourth seal is the Unnamed Crown. In the Unnamed King's castle in Anu Village, kill Tolo Grimsteel and Ganron Lorebane for their gems, then call up the king himself.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill Tolo Grimsteel in the Unnamed King's castle in Anu Village and take his gem.
Kill Ganron Lorebane and take his gem.
Call up the Unnamed King at the column, kill him and take his crown.
Tell Lord Tearis Thex you hold all four seals.
steps.says: Four of four. Now Oransan.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-2-good.json, Group 2, Level 49, The Fourth Seal (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The Unnamed King stands in his castle always (the guide's is called up at a column with both gems). His crown is the database's Crown of the Unnamed.

quests.name: Parathior
quests.offer: Take all four seals to Oransan at the broken tower in the north Snowblind Plains, west of the bear cave. He will call Parathior down. Bring me what is left of it.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and save everything.

steps.journal: Show the four seals to Oransan at the broken tower in the north Snowblind Plains.
steps.says: All four. Speak with Orinas while I begin; then the ice will fall from the sky.

steps.journal: Speak with Orinas, the bear, beside Oransan.
steps.says: When it is done, the weapon you have earned will be yours. Now, look up!

steps.journal: Kill Parathior and take a chunk of its ice.
Bring the ice chunk to Lord Tearis Thex.
steps.says: It is over. Take your reward, and when you have grown to the height of your power, the Recruiter will have work for you.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-2-good.json, Group 2, Level 49, Parathior and Quest completion (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The ritual's five minutes are not in; Parathior stands by the tower (the guide's comes down from the sky). Lord Tearis Thex gives the final rewards; the guide's class approval tasks are not in. The four orbs are this group's first and second seals (the guide lists them before the third). Epic weapons are epics_49.json's first that exists here.

quests.name: Bardif's Butler
quests.offer: Find Bardif's butler, Mergmar, in Qeynos: from the main gate go west, west again, south through the long hall, then the first door east. Show him my token.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Show Daresh's token to Mergmar, Bardif's butler, in Qeynos.
steps.says: Daresh sent you? Then go to Pwin, a dark elf in the north of Highpass, in the corral by the gate that is not the coach's. He knows who took the boy.
steps.notyet: I have nothing to say to strangers about my master.

steps.journal: Find Pwin in the corral in the north of Highpass.
steps.says: I keep my ears open, that is all. The orcs of the Bloodfoot stronghold in Hate Spike held a boy one night.

steps.journal: Report to Daresh in Murnf.
steps.says: The Bloodfoot orcs. Their jailor will know where the boy went.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-3-good.json, Group 3, Level 30 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Pwin is spelt as the server has him (a trailing space aside).

quests.name: The Jailor
quests.offer: The Bloodfoot jailor in Mount Hate Spike held Tarlin a night. West up the first snowy valley is the stronghold; the jailor is down the ramp, at the end of the hall.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Mind the bandits: they see through invisibility.

steps.journal: Kill the Bloodfoot jailor in the stronghold in Mount Hate Spike and take his note.
Bring the note to Daresh.
steps.says: Unreadable, to me. But Bardif's messenger Ricser waits at the Lost Watch Fort inn, north of Wyndhaven. He will read it, for a price.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-3-good.json, Group 3, Level 30, The Jailor (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The Bloodfoot bandits see the invisible.

quests.name: Bardif's Messenger
quests.offer: Ricser, Bardif's messenger, waits at the inn of Lost Watch Fort, north along the road from Wyndhaven. Pay him what he asks.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Pay Ricser 1,600 tunar at the Lost Watch Fort inn, north of Wyndhaven.
steps.says: The note says the boy was taken to the Green Rift, to meet one Ziliq. You did not hear it from me.

steps.journal: Tell Daresh what Ricser said.
steps.says: The Green Rift. Ziliq keeps a temple in the side of the rift, far west of Bobble-by-Water.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-3-good.json, Group 3, Level 30, Ricser (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT).

quests.name: The Ring of Gal'Saris
quests.offer: Ziliq keeps a temple in the side of the Green Rift, a long run west of Bobble-by-Water. Take what he carries, then seek out Kipcah at Marr's Fist.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Bind in Murnf first: it is a long run.

steps.journal: Kill Ziliq in his temple in the Green Rift and take the Ring of Gal'Saris.
Show the Ring of Gal'Saris to Kipcah at Marr's Fist, by the Temple of Light, west of Freeport's north gate.
steps.says: Gal'Saris! The boy passed this way, then. A Deathfist lookout stole my spyglass; with it I could tell you where they took him.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-3-good.json, Group 3, Level 30, Ziliq and Kipcah (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT).

quests.name: Kipcah's Spyglass
quests.offer: A Deathfist lookout stole my spyglass: he is in a hut in the south-west of Deathfist Forge. Bring it back.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill the Deathfist lookout in his hut in Deathfist Forge and take the spyglass.
Bring the spyglass to Kipcah.
steps.says: Broken! Gligbin, by the wagon just inside the white gate of Klick'Anon, can mend it.

steps.journal: Take the spyglass to Gligbin, by the wagon just inside the white gate of Klick'Anon.
steps.says: A cracked lens, nothing more. There. No charge.

steps.journal: Bring the mended spyglass to Kipcah.
steps.says: I can see him: Tarlin is chained at the top of the ramp in the south of Deathfist Forge. Urtwar has the key.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-3-good.json, Group 3, Level 30, Kipcah (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Gligbin is the server's Gligbin Gearcharmer.

quests.name: Free Tarlin
quests.offer: Urtwar, at the top of the ramp in the south of Deathfist Forge, keeps the key to Tarlin's shackles. Kill him and set the boy free.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: A cleric partway up the ramp sees the invisible.

steps.journal: Kill Urtwar at the top of the ramp in the south of Deathfist Forge and take the shackle key.
Unlock Tarlin with the orc shackle key.
steps.says: Free! Tell my father... no. Tell Daresh I am free.

steps.journal: Return to Daresh in Murnf.
steps.says: The boy is free, and Bardif never knew who asked. Take what you have earned.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-3-good.json, Group 3, Level 30, Free Tarlin and Quest completion (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The choices: the ability on the class's line (the druid's fire line, as its level 40 choice; the magician's mark line, as the evil magicians' level 20) and the first weapon (magicians the second, the Staff of Dooog, which this database has; druids and rangers made like one of the kind and level).

quests.name: Amends to Bardif
quests.offer: Tarlin came home angry, and has taken up the necromancer's arts. Bardif blames the druids. Pay him 3,000 tunar in amends, at his house in Qeynos, and talk to Mergmar.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Mind Julie Tanner, if you wear a were's shape.

steps.journal: Pay Bardif 3,000 tunar at his house in Qeynos, second floor.
steps.says: Amends. Hmph. It will not bring my son back as he was.

steps.journal: Speak with Mergmar, downstairs from Bardif.
steps.says: The boy always loved the floating towers of the north.

steps.journal: Report to Daresh in Murnf.
steps.says: Floating towers. Then he is gathering men. His bandits hold the two towers of the fort on the hill east of Wyndhaven, by the ravine.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-3-good.json, Group 3, Level 40, Bardif and Mergmar (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The guide warns were-forms of Julie Tanner, the werehunter in Bardif's house.

quests.name: Tarlin's Bandits
quests.offer: Tarlin's bandits hold the two towers of the fort on the hill east of Wyndhaven, near the ravine. Bring me what they carry.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill Tarlin's bandits in the towers of the fort east of Wyndhaven until one carries a note.
Bring the bandit's note to Daresh.
steps.says: They mean to kill Bardif. An assassin is already in his house!

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-3-good.json, Group 3, Level 40, Bandits (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT).

quests.name: The Assassin in Bardif's House
quests.offer: One of Tarlin's assassins is in Bardif's house in Qeynos. Go there, and kill him before he kills Bardif.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Go into Bardif's house in Qeynos and kill the assassin who waits there.
Bring the assassin's dagger to Daresh.
steps.says: Tarlin sent three messengers out besides: to the Blacktongue orcs of Ferran's Hope, to Deathfist Citadel and to the Great Waste.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-3-good.json, Group 3, Level 40, Assassin (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The assassin stands in Bardif's house (EQOA-Data's map point; the guide's attacks as the player comes in).

quests.name: Tarlin's Agents
quests.offer: Tarlin's agents carry his orders to the Blacktongue village in Ferran's Hope, to Deathfist Citadel, and to the main building in the north-east of the Great Waste. Stop all three.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill Tarlin's agents in Ferran's Hope, Deathfist Citadel and the Great Waste and take their three notes.
Bring the three agents' notes to Daresh.
steps.says: He is making a necromancer's gems: the Gem of Night and the Rune of Corpses. Take them before he can.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-3-good.json, Group 3, Level 40, Three Messengers (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The agents stand at their three places always (the guide's are triggered).

quests.name: Necromantic Gems
quests.offer: Vahk'Kiv in the south of Guk keeps the Gem of Night; Daglader in the Tomb of Kings the Rune of Corpses. Take them both.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Kill Vahk'Kiv in the south of Guk for the Gem of Night.
Kill Daglader in the Tomb of Kings for the Rune of Corpses.
Bring the gem and the rune to Daresh.
steps.says: Without them he is weaker. Now go and face him: he waits beneath his floating tower in the south-east of Bogman Village.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-3-good.json, Group 3, Level 40, Necromantic Gems (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT).

quests.name: Tarlin's Guards
quests.offer: Tarlin waits beneath his floating tower in the south-east of Bogman Village, north of Wyndhaven. Go and face him. He will not come alone.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Go to the foot of Tarlin's floating tower in the south-east of Bogman Village.

events.text: Tarlin stands beneath his tower. "You! My father's dog!" Three thugs step out of the shadows.

steps.journal: Kill Tarlin's three thugs.
Return to Daresh in Murnf.
steps.says: You lived. Tarlin will not forget it, and nor will we. Take what you have earned.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-3-good.json, Group 3, Level 40, Tarlin's Guards and Quest completion (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The three thugs are copies of Tarlin's guards brought to the player for the step (the guide's spawn under the tower; "kill or die" there: here they are to be killed). The choices: the first ability and weapon (made like one of the kind and level where this database lacks it; the monk's Pinewood Tonfa is here).

quests.name: Three Robes
quests.offer: Three of Tarlin's teachers must die: Arifr Beguile in Gunter's Mines, Malitor Weatherskin in the Elemental Towers of Hazinak, Yaymz Searingtouch in Cazic Thule. Bring me their robes; keep all else.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Keep everything until the end.

steps.journal: Kill Arifr Beguile in Gunter's Mines for his robe.
Kill Malitor Weatherskin in the Elemental Towers of Hazinak for his robe.
Kill Yaymz Searingtouch in Cazic Thule for his robe. His guards can harm with a touch.
Bring the three robes to Daresh.
steps.says: Now his tower's secrets: three ciphers. The centaurs of the Elephant Graveyard, the antlion larva cave in the Sea of Lions and the pit of the Box Canyons hide them.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-3-good.json, Group 3, Level 49, Three Robes (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT).

quests.name: Three Ciphers
quests.offer: Three ciphers unlock Tarlin's tower: in the centaur village of the Elephant Graveyard, the antlion larva cave of the Sea of Lions, and the pit in the south of the Box Canyons.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Search the centaur village in the west of the Elephant Graveyard for the first cipher.

events.text: Among the centaurs' things you find a cipher.

steps.journal: Search the antlion larva cave in the Sea of Lions for the second cipher.

events.text: Deep in the larva cave you find a second cipher.

steps.journal: Search the pit guardian's place in the south of the Box Canyons for the third cipher.

events.text: In the pit, under the drakes' eyes, lies the third cipher.

steps.journal: Bring the three ciphers to Daresh.
steps.says: Now buy a teleport gem from Sorroian, in the east of Bogman Village, and go up into his tower.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-3-good.json, Group 3, Level 49, Three Ciphers (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The ciphers are places to reach (EQOA-Data's map points; the guide's pit guardian is not fought). The antlion cave's and the drakes' creatures see the invisible.

quests.name: Tarlin's Floating Tower
quests.offer: Buy a teleport gem from Sorroian, in the east of Bogman Village, for 5,000 tunar. Use it at the floating tower, and end Tarlin. Bring me his robe.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, and come back to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Buy a teleport gem from Sorroian in the east of Bogman Village: 5,000 tunar.
steps.says: A gem to the tower. Do not lose it.

steps.journal: Use the teleport gem at the foot of Tarlin's floating tower in the south-east of Bogman Village.

events.text: The gem flares, and the tower takes you in. Tarlin's guard bars the way.

steps.journal: Kill Tarlin's guard.
Kill Tarlin and his pet and take his robe.
Bring Tarlin's robe to Daresh.
steps.says: It is done. One thing more: his master, Lord Chardith. Archmagus Terathin in Takish Hiz can call him.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-3-good.json, Group 3, Level 49, Tarlin's Floating Tower (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Tarlin, his guard and his pet stand at the tower always; the gem's lift is a popup at the tower's foot, not a teleport (the tower's top is not known here).

quests.name: To Summon Chardith
quests.offer: Archmagus Terathin, in the basement of the building with the blue lightning bolt sign in south-west Takish Hiz, can call Lord Chardith. Help him, and bring me a bone of Chardith.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Kill the magi only after you have spoken to Terathin.

steps.journal: Find Archmagus Terathin in the basement of the building with the blue lightning bolt sign in south-west Takish Hiz.
steps.says: You would help me destroy the Magi? Kill the Magus of the Sun, the Magus of the Stars and the Magus of the Moon, and bring me their phylacteries. Only after we have spoken.

steps.journal: Fight through the sun knights and kill the Magus of the Sun for his phylactery.
Fight through the star wisps and kill the Magus of the Stars for his phylactery.
Clear the moon wraiths and kill the Magus of the Moon for his phylactery.
Bring the three phylacteries to Archmagus Terathin.
steps.says: All three. Choose your weapon from the jeweled chest; then speak to me, and I will call him.

steps.journal: Open the jeweled chest beside Archmagus Terathin and choose your weapon.

events.text: You choose your weapon from the jeweled chest. It will be yours when your path is done. The choice is final.

steps.journal: Speak to Archmagus Terathin again to call Lord Chardith.
steps.says: Then it begins. Lord Chardith! Your servant calls you!

steps.journal: Kill Lord Chardith and take a bone of Chardith.
Bring the bone of Chardith to Daresh.
steps.says: Chardith is gone, and your path is yours. Take what you have earned. When you have grown to the height of your power, the Recruiter will have work for you.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/30,40,49/group-3-good.json, Group 3, Level 49, To Summon Chardith and Quest completion (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Lord Chardith and the three magi stand in the basement always (the guide's Chardith is called after a sacrifice; Terathin speaks only every fifteen minutes). The jeweled chest's choice is the class's first weapon, given at the end. Daresh gives the final rewards; the guide's class NPC and approval notes are not in. Epic weapons are the guide's first (druids' and rangers' made like one of the kind and level).
